title: FOC motor controller
spec: 12S bus · 10 A RMS · STM32G431 + DRV8323S · CAN-FD
summary: A single-axis, sensored field-oriented-control motor controller for one joint of a cat-scale bipedal robot: 70 × 70 mm, 6 layers. Rev 1 is fabricated and partly bench-validated on a 12 V supply, with a motor identified and spun open-loop up to 1000 rpm.
